title: Root-owned runtime release boundaries
summary: Restored root ownership after Cloudron startup normalization so application code cannot relax immutable release and deployment-control permissions.
changes: Made the launcher accept only the verified Cloudron ownership-normalization contract, restore root ownership synchronously, and refuse Apache startup until the protected runtime boundary is verified.
Added post-restart ownership restoration and complete ownership verification for active and rollback releases while retaining writable Laravel cache and shared-storage paths.
affected_areas: Cloudron application startup, immutable release ownership, and rollback verification
version_rationale: A backward-compatible patch correcting the ownership-control gap found during v0.8.2 production acceptance.
validation: Deployment contracts require root ownership for protected runtime paths and every immutable-release path outside Laravel bootstrap cache, with the shared environment root-owned and readable only by the application group.

The post-restart gate restores ownership before reading the retained archive, reauthenticates deployment controls, preserves only required cache and storage writes, and reruns exact release health, OIDC, and authorization checks.
known_limitations: This patch changes deployment ownership enforcement only; it does not alter the v0.8.0 authorization or Admin feature set.
rollback: Restore the exact pre-activation application release while retaining the forward-only Phase B database migration; rollback remains fail-closed unless the previous release and authenticated controls retain root-owned immutable boundaries.
provenance: Defined by v0.8.2 production ownership evidence for Phase B of MyAPES Account issue #10.
